steps.what: Signal or verbally direct workers during hoisting and moving loads

tasks.design: Keep signaling and verbal direction with the rigger observing the operation. A lift plan stored in {DOCS} can support preparation without replacing live directions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Movement directions depend on changing worker positions, visibility and actual load behavior.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital plans support preparation but provide no demonstrated substitute for this live task.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected movement and changing obstructions require immediate situational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The rigger observes the actual operation and communicates clear directions to the crew.
tasks.altitude: Live direction and its time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clear crew communication and recognition of changing installation constraints

evidence.claim: A stored plan does not replace live observation and signaling during load movement; no saving is established for the proposed unchanged task.

assumptions: Boundary covers the rigger's signaling and verbal directions during a lift, not lift planning or hoisting work performed by other crew members.
The rigger interprets positions, motion and conditions directly during s1. No pre-existing structured safe-to-move flag or automated visual clearance is assumed.
Consider native document access for plans before custom tools; no new software is introduced here.
Zero incremental upkeep because the operation and its communication process remain unchanged. Other crew effort is neither transferred nor counted as a focal-role saving.
unknowns: Communication arrangements and visibility at actual sites
research_questions: Is there distinct preparation paperwork outside live signaling that can improve separately?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Repetitive lifts and obstructed sites retain live observation and direction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select rigging gear for the load and site

steps.what: Assess load weights, sizes, site facilities and work schedules for gear selection
Select cables, pulleys and winches suited to assessed lifting requirements

tasks.design: Keep assessment and gear selection with the rigger. Native equipment records in a maintenance system {OTHER} may provide reference information without automatically certifying suitability for a specific lift.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selection combines actual load and site conditions with equipment limitations.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital equipment records can make known specifications available, but they do not resolve incomplete load information or site judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Actual attachment geometry, gear condition and practical site constraints need competent assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The rigger recognizes when available information or equipment is insufficient.
tasks.altitude: Gear selection responsibility and working time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Plan equipment access for machinery installation
reach.learn: Installation constraints and practical equipment coordination

evidence.claim: Maintenance records can hold equipment history; Ultimo provides preventive plans and repair history, which do not establish lift-specific suitability.
This unchanged assessment and selection design has no measured labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary covers the rigger's assessment and selection, excluding gear procurement, inspection by separate specialists and performance of the lift.

The rigger produces assessed lifting requirements in s1 from available load information and site examination. Missing load data require further verification; no structured load weight, verified capacity or suitability flag is supplied to an automated decision.
OTHER denotes a maintenance records system. Test native reference access before a custom calculator; no separate manual calculation baseline is assumed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new calculation, data capture or selection system is introduced. Record maintenance already performed by others is unchanged.
unknowns: Existing equipment records and selection procedures
research_questions: Is repetitive calculation a distinct measured part of selection with verified inputs and independent checks?

incremental.description: No new gear selection automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 minus0 upkeep gives net0. Familiar gear combinations and unusual loads retain load verification and site-specific selection.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The rigger retains live movement coordination and responsibility for gear selection.
reach: Coordinate installation constraints with industrial machinery mechanics
skills_to_grow: Recognizing insufficient load and site information
role.ambitious_version: A rigger who uses reliable reference information while retaining direct observation and competent physical assessment.
